regimeSub: Warsh's Jackson Hole hawkish pivot anchors regime as BOK's Shin decouples from Fed, weak US growth persists.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole (Aug 28) explicitly signals rate hikes if 3.3% CPI persists → economists now betting on hike per Reuters; DXY slips to 99.58 as markets digest hawkish uncertainty

BOK Governor Shin hikes to 3.00% back-to-back (Aug 27), explicitly states Korea 'won't automatically follow U.S. rate moves' (Aug 31 Businesskorea) → KRW strengthens to 1373, policy divergence narrative entrenched
US stagflation data stack hardens: Q2 GDP confirmed 1.5% (Aug 26), July NFP -23k (Aug 7), CPI 3.3% YoY → ING notes spending stalls while inflation makes 'slow progress' toward target
Memory chip rout extends post-Nvidia: Samsung/SK Hynix drop despite TSMC capex upgrade (Jul 16 Reuters) → KOSPI falls to 6710 as HBM valuation reset spreads from US to Korea

headline: Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole hawkish pivot entrenches stagflation regime as BOK's Shin decouples with back-to-back hikes while US growth stalls at 1.5% against 3.3% inflation.
